source.title: Career catalogue written for Prospero Dungeon
source.note: General descriptions of common occupations for fiction; not labour statistics.

careers.name: Registered nurse
careers.summary: Twelve-hour hospital shifts, three or four a week.

careers.name: Night-shift nurse
careers.summary: Overnight hospital shifts on a three-night rotation.

careers.name: Resident physician
careers.summary: Long training rotations in a teaching hospital.

careers.name: Biomedical researcher
careers.summary: Lab work and grant writing at a research institution.

careers.name: Pharmacist
careers.summary: Dispensing and counselling at a hospital or retail pharmacy.

careers.name: Software engineer
careers.summary: Building and maintaining software on a product team.

careers.name: Data analyst
careers.summary: Reports, dashboards and questions from other teams.

careers.name: Product designer
careers.summary: Designing interfaces and running user research.

careers.name: Financial analyst
careers.summary: Modelling, quarterly reporting and client decks.

careers.name: Accountant
careers.summary: Bookkeeping, audits and tax season.

careers.name: Paralegal
careers.summary: Case files, filings and research for a law firm.

careers.name: Public school teacher
careers.summary: Teaching a full day of classes, plus grading at home.

careers.name: University lecturer
careers.summary: Lectures, office hours and research.

careers.name: Graduate student
careers.summary: Coursework, research and teaching assistant hours.

careers.name: College student
careers.summary: Full-time classes with a part-time job on the side.

careers.name: Barista
careers.summary: Opening shifts at a busy coffee shop.

careers.name: Line cook
careers.summary: Dinner service in a restaurant kitchen.

careers.name: Bartender
careers.summary: Evening and late shifts behind a bar.

careers.name: Restaurant server
careers.summary: Waiting tables through lunch and dinner service.

careers.name: Hotel front desk agent
careers.summary: Check-ins, guest requests and the occasional crisis.

careers.name: Casino table dealer
careers.summary: Dealing table games on rotating casino shifts.

careers.name: Event planner
careers.summary: Planning conferences, weddings and corporate events.

careers.name: Retail associate
careers.summary: Floor and register shifts at a store.

careers.name: Baker
careers.summary: Pre-dawn baking for a neighbourhood bakery.

careers.name: Graphic designer
careers.summary: Branding and layout work for an agency or freelance clients.

careers.name: Working musician
careers.summary: Gigs, rehearsals and teaching lessons.

careers.name: Reporter
careers.summary: Reporting and writing for a local newsroom.

careers.name: Marketing coordinator
careers.summary: Campaigns, social posts and launch calendars.

careers.name: Logistics coordinator
careers.summary: Scheduling shipments and freight for a port or warehouse.

careers.name: Navy sailor
careers.summary: Duty rotations on base or aboard ship.

careers.name: Aerospace engineer
careers.summary: Engineering work for a defense or aerospace contractor.

careers.name: Biotech scientist
careers.summary: Bench science in a biotech or life sciences company.

careers.name: Biologist
careers.summary: Field work, samples and reports for a university, agency, aquarium or conservation group.

careers.name: Personal trainer
careers.summary: Early and evening client sessions at a gym.

careers.name: Tour guide
careers.summary: Walking and bus tours for visitors.

careers.name: Stage performer
careers.summary: Nightly shows with rehearsals in the day.

careers.name: Real estate agent
careers.summary: Showings, open houses and closings.

careers.name: Electrician
careers.summary: Job sites starting at dawn.

careers.name: Government policy analyst
careers.summary: Policy research and briefings for a public agency.

careers.name: Social worker
careers.summary: Casework and home visits.

careers.name: Investment banker
careers.summary: Long hours on deals at a bank.

careers.name: Fashion assistant
careers.summary: Fittings, samples and showroom days.

careers.name: Actor
careers.summary: Auditions, classes and the occasional booking.

careers.name: Lifeguard
careers.summary: Beach or pool shifts in the warm months.

careers.name: Surf instructor
careers.summary: Morning lessons for beginners.

careers.name: Telephone operator
careers.summary: Plugging calls through at a telephone exchange switchboard, headset on, "Number, please."

careers.name: Newsboy
careers.summary: Hawking the morning and evening editions on a busy corner.

careers.name: Stenographer
careers.summary: Taking dictation in shorthand and typing letters in an office typing pool.

careers.name: Office clerk
careers.summary: Ledgers, filing and invoices at a desk in a big firm downtown.

careers.name: Speakeasy bartender
careers.summary: Mixing bathtub gin into cocktails behind an unmarked door, with one eye on the street.

careers.name: Jazz musician
careers.summary: Playing hot jazz in clubs and dance halls, then jamming after hours.

careers.name: Chorus dancer
careers.summary: Kicking in the line of a revue: two shows a night and rehearsals by day.

careers.name: Hatcheck attendant
careers.summary: Minding coats and hats at a nightclub or smart restaurant, living on tips.

careers.name: Longshoreman
careers.summary: Loading and unloading ships at the piers, hired by the day at the shape-up.

careers.name: Fisherman
careers.summary: Out before dawn on a fishing boat, back to sell the catch at the wharf.

careers.name: Streetcar motorman
careers.summary: Driving a streetcar along its line while the conductor takes the fares.

careers.name: Taxi driver
careers.summary: Driving a cab for a fleet, cruising for fares day or night.

careers.name: Chauffeur
careers.summary: Driving and keeping the motorcar for a wealthy family.

careers.name: Pullman porter
careers.summary: Making up berths and seeing to passengers on overnight sleeping cars, days away from home.

careers.name: Department store clerk
careers.summary: Selling behind a counter at a big department store, under the floorwalker's eye.

careers.name: Grocer
careers.summary: Running a corner grocery: credit for regulars, deliveries and a long day.

careers.name: Soda jerk
careers.summary: Pulling sodas and sundaes at a drugstore fountain, with a paper hat and the slang to match.

careers.name: Iceman
careers.summary: Delivering blocks of ice up the stairs to iceboxes on a regular route.

careers.name: Milkman
careers.summary: Delivering milk, cream and eggs door to door before dawn.

careers.name: Factory hand
careers.summary: Long shifts on a factory line, six days a week, with the whistle marking the day.

careers.name: Textile mill hand
careers.summary: Tending looms or spinning frames in a textile mill, deafened by the noise.

careers.name: Garment worker
careers.summary: Sewing piecework at a machine in a garment loft.

careers.name: Housemaid
careers.summary: Cleaning, laundry and serving for a well-off household, live-in or by the day.

careers.name: Garage mechanic
careers.summary: Fixing motorcars and trucks at a garage and filling station.

careers.name: Radio repairman
careers.summary: Building and fixing the new home radio sets, and selling a few.

careers.name: Telegraph operator
careers.summary: Sending and receiving telegrams in Morse at a telegraph office.

careers.name: Linotype operator
careers.summary: Setting the newspaper's type on a clattering Linotype before the presses roll.

careers.name: Police patrolman
careers.summary: Walking a beat and calling in from the box on the corner.

careers.name: Private detective
careers.summary: Tailing husbands, finding missing persons and serving papers out of a small office.

careers.name: Lawyer
careers.summary: Wills, contracts and court days at a downtown practice.

careers.name: Bank teller
careers.summary: Counting cash behind the brass grille at a bank.

careers.name: Stockbroker
careers.summary: Buying and selling on the ticker for clients, many of them on margin.

careers.name: Trained nurse
careers.summary: Ward duty at a hospital in a starched cap, or private nursing in a patient's home.

careers.name: Physician
careers.summary: Office hours and house calls with a black bag.

careers.name: Druggist
careers.summary: Mixing prescriptions at the drugstore counter, whiskey "for medicinal purposes" included.

careers.name: Librarian
careers.summary: Lending, cataloguing and reading-room duty at a public or college library.

careers.name: Museum curator
careers.summary: Cataloguing collections, mounting exhibits and corresponding with collectors.

careers.name: Antiquarian bookseller
careers.summary: Buying and selling old and rare books from a cramped shop, and hunting them at estate sales.

careers.name: Minister
careers.summary: Sunday sermons, weddings, funerals and calls on the sick of the parish.

careers.name: Undertaker
careers.summary: Running the funeral parlor: laying out the dead, arranging services, comforting families.

careers.name: Bootlegger
careers.summary: Running illegal liquor from the boats and the stills to the speakeasies.

careers.name: Subscription content creator
careers.summary: Self-employed: shoots and edits explicit photo and video sets for a paid fan page (OnlyFans, Fansly), answers subscriber messages, fills custom requests and promotes the page on social media. Income swings month to month and the platform takes 20 percent.

careers.name: Webcam model
careers.summary: Streams live explicit shows on a cam site from a corner of the apartment set up with ring lights, paid in tips and private shows; the good hours are late evenings and weekends.

careers.name: Exotic dancer
careers.summary: Dances topless or nude at a strip club as an independent contractor: pays the house a fee each shift, tips the DJ and the bouncers, and earns from stage sets and private dances.

careers.name: Adult film performer
careers.summary: Performs in sex scenes for adult studios, booked through an agent; tests for STIs every two weeks, shoots a few days a month and runs their own social media and fan page between bookings.

careers.name: Phone sex operator
careers.summary: Takes explicit calls and paid sexting sessions from home for a chat line, paid by the minute; keeps a headset, a log of regular callers and a voice that does not match their day.

careers.name: Adult store clerk
careers.summary: Works the register and floor at an adult store: checks IDs at the door, explains toys and lube to nervous shoppers, restocks lingerie and handles returns that cannot be resold.

careers.name: Professional dominatrix
careers.summary: Runs paid BDSM sessions by appointment in a rented dungeon: screens clients, agrees limits and safewords in advance and keeps the equipment clean. Sessions are kink, not sex.

careers.name: Burlesque performer
careers.summary: Performs striptease acts in neo-burlesque shows at bars and small theatres, makes their own costumes and pasties, and teaches a weekly class to cover rent.

careers.name: Glamour model
careers.summary: Poses for lingerie, topless and nude shoots for photographers, magazines and paid sites; books jobs through a profile and an agency and sells prints and sets on the side.

careers.name: Erotica author
careers.summary: Writes and self-publishes explicit romance and erotica e-books under a pen name, a novella every few weeks to stay visible in the store rankings.

careers.name: Adult video editor
careers.summary: Cuts scenes, color-corrects and writes descriptions for an adult studio, often remotely; sees hours of explicit footage a day and finds it about as exciting as spreadsheets.

careers.name: Burlesque dancer
careers.summary: Strips in a burlesque house between the comics: three or four shows a night, run by the house manager and raided by the police now and then.

careers.name: Artists' model
careers.summary: Poses nude for art classes and painters by the hour: long holds in a cold studio, gossip on the breaks.
